name: Rikushima Fumika
source:
Works as a receptionist for some famous electrical company.
Slightly older than Souichi and others, and exudes a sense of composure.

Has strong morals, and refuses to be caught up in the game. Encourages everyone to not fight and instead cooperate to find a way out together.
A reliable young woman.

"Maybe this is the crossroads of fate..."

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=614865]Getchu[/url]]
